# k8s-resource-advisor

> Recommend Kubernetes CPU and memory requests and limits from usage samples with percentile math, exact quantity parsing and ready-to-paste resources YAML Python package `trysac-k8s-resource-advisor`, import name `k8s_resource_advisor`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
